language.script: Latin (Rumi); Jawi (Arabic-derived script) retains official/ceremonial status alongside it

terrainDescription.zh: 分為馬來半島與婆羅洲島上的東馬，熱帶雨林覆蓋率高，吉隆坡等西海岸城市高度都市化
terrainDescription.en: Split between Peninsular Malaysia and East Malaysia on Borneo; extensive rainforest cover, with west-coast cities like Kuala Lumpur highly urbanized

plate.color: white text on black background, front and rear alike (exceptions: taxis, dealers, diplomats)

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Black, white, grey and red are the common bollard colors; notably, Malaysia is one of the few countries whose street markings never use yellow — a useful distinguishing clue from neighboring Indonesia/Philippines

utilityPole.transformerMount: No strongly distinctive documented transformer-mount pattern found — treat as a lower-confidence field

historicalContext.zh: 前英國殖民地，靠左行駛，多元族群（馬來人／華人／印度人）使路牌常見多語言並列。
historicalContext.en: A former British colony that drives on the left; its multi-ethnic population (Malay/Chinese/Indian) means signage often carries multiple languages side by side.
